def answer():
    r"""

    Inputs

        (1) $x_1=1+i$, $x_2=2$, $x_3=3$, $x_4=4$, $x_5=5$
        (2) $x_1=1$, $x_2=2$, $x_3=3$, $x_4=4$, $x_5=5$
    """

    # ------------------ FILL IN YOUR RESULTS BELOW ------------------
    corr_1 = 0.2748 + 0.0455j  # Complex value for Case (1)
    corr_2 = 0.4377            # Real value for Case (2)
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------

    return corr_1, corr_2
